guia.what: A dropdown menu of actions anchored to a trigger (APG menu pattern). The trigger has `data-ts-menu-trigger`; the panel has `data-ts-menu-panel`, with `ts menu-item`, `ts menu-separator`, and `ts menu-label` inside. It’s for running actions, not for choosing a value.
whenUse: Grouping secondary actions behind a button (“⋯”, “Options”).
The actions don’t fit comfortably in the toolbar, but they’re used often.
Each item does something (navigate, edit, delete) and doesn’t leave a value selected.
whenAvoid: You’re choosing a form value that stays selected → `select`.
The menu opens with a right-click on some content → `context-menu`.
dos: Group items with `ts menu-label` and `ts menu-separator`, and keep destructive actions apart and at the end.
The trigger needs an accessible name (text or `aria-label`).
donts: Don’t put a form inside. It’s a list of actions, not a panel → `popover`.
Don’t hide the screen’s primary action inside a menu.

teclado.action: Goes to the first / last item.
Closes the menu, and focus moves on to the next element on the page (it doesn’t move through the items).
Closes and returns focus to the trigger.

nucleo: The Popover API shows the menu, but doesn’t navigate it. The keyboard and submenus are Core’s. The APG menu pattern—programmatic focus on the items (`tabindex="-1"`), ↑ ↓, Home and End, Tab to close, opening submenus, and cascading close.
